title: +THEORIES OF RACE AND ETHNICITY
description: Examines various theories of race and ethnicity, their historical contexts, and applications. Explores critically how race shapes society from the individual to the institutional and structural levels. Applies theoretical frameworks for the study of race and racism to everyday life across contexts. Focuses on identifying connections between the personal and the systemic.
recommendations: Completion of a Difference, Power, and Oppression Foundations course; Analytical, critical thinking, and synthesis skills
